They brought their extensive networks in the worlds of business, academia, and the public and non-profit sectors into the Service team. For example, Climate-KIC are an official member of the Copernicus Academy since 2018 which has equipped them with an exceptional insight into the educational and training landscape of the Copernicus Programme - a critical requirement for this work. In addition, Climate-KIC is already active across Europe and online, running a range of inspirational education programmes for students, postgraduates, and professionals. This is in alignment with the requirements of the Service contract, specifically in delivering high-quality, customised Training events for the 2 Copernicus Services (Atmospheric and Climate) operated by the ECMWF. Within their staff, Climate-KIC also had the required expertise in event management, professional networks, Copernicus activities, Copernicus product uses, and product & service development that was needed for the Service’s Scientific Advisory Committee - a key Quality Control mechanism embedded within the contract Service – in addition to their highly beneficial professional networks. This is in close alignment with the requirements of the overarching Service contract between UCC and the ECMWF, specifically to deliver high-quality, customised online and in-person training events that are quality controlled to a standard of high scientific and professional rigour. The company was therefore selected to participate in the bid for the CJS2_156b ITT as their unique combination of skillsets, technical expertise, capabilities and networks complemented those of the bidding consortium, completing it’s offering to the ECMWF. They were integral to the awarded bid, and have been contracted accordingly.
